What is TOHEE?

Town of Host: Enhanced-Enhanced (TOHEE) is a host-only Among Us mod. The host runs the mod on a Windows PC and controls the room rules; other players can usually join with unmodified game clients. TOHEE adds roles, factions, game modes, and room options. The current release determines what is available.

TOHEE builds on the upstream Town of Host: Enhanced project. Older upstream pages may describe different packages, settings files, and procedures; this documentation has been updated for current TOHEE behavior. Get the release that matches your game platform and architecture from TOHEE GitHub Releases.

Start here

  • Install the mod, then read how to update it.
  • Set up a room with the game, system, and mod settings.
  • Game modes covers current Standard, FFA, and TOHE Hide & Seek, plus a historical upstream mode.
  • Use commands and hotkeys, presets, and chat templates to manage your room.
  • For Cloud accounts, linked game accounts, or Cloud player tags, see the TOHEE Cloud guide.
  • Adjust built-in ability effects in the Custom Sound Manager, and learn the mod's Cloud buttons in the in-mod Cloud interface guide.

Only the host needs to install the mod. Joining players still need an Among Us game version compatible with the host; mobile, tablet, and console players cannot install this Windows mod, but may join a room where the game supports it.

Scope and freshness

Some material is based on older upstream TOHE guides. When you encounter old download links, Discord tags, TOHE-DATA paths, or legacy preset steps, follow the current release package, TOHEE menus, and this guide instead. Older upstream pages described Speedrun; the current TOHEE game-mode list is different. See game modes.
